facts.text: A dump split value other than heading, file or none is rejected with invalid_split, recorded in the manifest errors.

facts.text: A supersedes ref must name a target that exists, or the post fails with supersedes_target_not_found.

at: an unknown name is rejected with

at: leaves out a fact that is stale or contested

facts.text: The search --q option takes an FTS5 query, and FTS5 syntax still works.

at: absent when that chain ends in a retraction

facts.text: Markdown publish takes --assets detail or none, while JSONL publish takes embed, files or none.
Markdown publish defaults to a budget of 1200 and depth full, with budget-mode complete.
A subject slug is capped at 80 characters, and a colliding slug gets a -2 or -3 suffix in tree order.
A fact file key is the first 8 hex characters of a SHA-256 of the normalized text, declared key, kind and canonical data.
at: the first 8 hex characters of the SHA-256

facts.text: A missing blob still lets publish write the markdown, renders the entry as MISSING, warns on stderr and exits 0.
Markdown-only options --facts, --budget, --budget-mode, --depth and --index-max-tokens are rejected with --format jsonl.
A blob over 256 MiB cannot be embedded and fails the publish.
at: cannot be embedded and fails the publish

facts.text: Publish fails with bundle_too_large_for_memory, writing nothing, when one data file would exceed about 2 GiB.
at: would exceed the runtime's array limit

facts.text: Every fact file ends with a Machine record heading and one fenced json block holding the canonical record.
at: ends with a `## Machine record` heading

facts.text: The --max-files limit counts the .jsonl files plus asset files and not manifest.json, and 0 means unbounded.
at: counts the `.jsonl` files plus asset files

facts.text: An unknown profile key or a wrongly typed field makes publish exit non-zero naming the field.
at: An unknown key or a wrongly typed field

facts.text: Microsoft Copilot Studio accepts 500 uploaded files per agent and degrades to document-level citations under about 4 KB.
In a profile, 0 means unbounded, and an absent allowed_extensions accepts any file type.
Shard mode writes no subject directories, fact files or assets, and attachments are listed by sha256.
Each shard opens with front matter naming shard, of, subjects and a fact_files value of absent.
Everything is built and measured in memory first, so a limit breach exits non-zero before anything is written.
at: Everything is built and measured in memory first

facts.text: Publish keeps the README timestamp while the rest of the bundle is unchanged.
at: The README timestamp is kept while the rest of the bundle is unchanged

facts.text: Files listed by a previous manifest but no longer produced are removed, while any other file in the directory is never deleted.
at: any other file in the directory is never deleted

facts.text: max_path_depth and min_file_bytes are report-only, so --respect-limits does not enforce them.

facts.text: import opens bundle files with explicit per-platform open flags for macOS, FreeBSD and Linux.
The linux-x64 archive needs Intel or AMD 64-bit Linux with glibc 2.34 or newer.

The dossier binary does not run without the native SQLite library kept beside it.
at: the binary does not run without it

facts.text: gh attestation verify needs GitHub CLI 2.49 or later, and SHA256SUMS itself is not attested.
The release workflow fails any Linux build that would need a glibc symbol version above 2.39.
at: fails any build that would need more than 2.39

facts.text: macOS binaries are unsigned, and a Gatekeeper block is cleared with xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine.
The osx-arm64 archive is for Apple Silicon Macs.
The win-x64 archive covers Windows x64, and Windows 11 on ARM runs it through built-in x64 emulation.
Each archive extracts into a single directory named dossier-<version>-<rid>.
On macOS, shasum -a 256 -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS verifies a download.
The attestations cover the four archives, and releases published before attestations were added have none.
at: the attestations cover the four archives

facts.text: Linux binaries need libicu and OpenSSL libssl3 as well as glibc 2.34 or newer.

at: Ubuntu 20.04 and Debian 11 are not supported

facts.text: The linux-arm64 archive is tested on GitHub's Ubuntu 24.04 arm64 runners.

A release tag must be on main and look like vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, with an optional prerelease suffix such as v1.2.3-rc.1.
A prerelease suffix on a release tag marks the GitHub release as a prerelease.
at: a suffix marks the GitHub release as a prerelease

facts.text: A release publishes the four archives plus SHA256SUMS, with the Windows asset named dossier-<version>-win-x64.zip.

The seed script prints subjects_created=5 and facts_created=32.
changes --since defaults to 0 and --limit to 100, and a page holds at most 500 rows.
